This laptop is building its own version of this release: it checks Google\'s release, applies OpenBook\'s adaptations again and verifies the result. It takes a few minutes, and you can keep using your laptop.
The next steps build the version of this release for this laptop, on the laptop itself. They arrive with a coming OpenBook update. The verified download is kept until then.
The version for this laptop is built and verified. Installing it needs this laptop\'s own update key to be recognized by the system, which comes with an OpenBook update. The build is kept until then.

If a release changes a part of the system this laptop needs adapted, or no longer fits, OpenBook Update stops and says so. It never installs a guess.
